articles.title: They Got Paid $12,000 to Move to West Virginia — and They're Staying!
articles.summary: Imagine getting paid to move to a place with mountains, rivers, and dark skies for stargazing! That's what happened to Ashley Eklin and others in the Ascend West Virginia program. They got $12,000 to relocate, and many are staying.

articles.title: New U.S. Tariffs Make Other Countries Mad — Here's Why
articles.summary: The U.S. just raised taxes on goods from countries like Australia and Japan, saying they use forced labor. But those countries say it's not true! Australia's trade minister called the tariffs "completely unjustified."

articles.title: New Prime Minister's First Week: Free Bus Rides? Cheaper Electricity?
articles.summary: Andy Burnham just became the UK's prime minister, and he's already making big promises. He wants to cap bus fares at £2, cut electricity bills, and end rough sleeping. But some experts wonder how he'll pay for it all.
